description:
Operating Area: Australia

Look no further and settle for no less when you see this stunning 35m superyacht. She gleams as she cruises Australasia & South Pacific. Built in 2015 by the famous Sunseeker Predator 115. Her exterior and interior are also designed by Sunseeker. It will be obvious to everyone when they see how stylish and proudly she presents herself.

Accommodating up to 10 guests with five cabins, shared amongst two large doubles and two twin rooms. Each room holds a similar theme. They are light and are furnished to a very high standard. The raised beds show just how high the ceilings are and create room for extra storage. The fabrics are silk and satin with pops of colour using cushions and throws. The furniture in the rooms are light wood and surround the room. The master ensuite bathroom is large with a jet spa bath tub and shower. The gloss wood continues in here. 

Leading upstairs on gloss tiled staircase, the lounge and dining room can be found on the main deck.

RASCAL's lounge room is surrounded with large windows allowing a lot of natural light. She has a lounge area with a mirrored square table and cream leather sofas. It is an idea space for using the onboard entertainment she has. Large flat screens can be viewed whilst enjoying the DVD player, Satcom, Satellite TV. It is a modern place to entertain. 
Her dining room table is mirrored and can seat up to 8 guests easily. Mirrored detail on the wall reflects and gives the impression of space. 

Her deck area is decked in light teak wood. Further entertaining takes places outside on comfortable white sofas round funky burnt orange tables. Here is the bar area completely white and crisps with tall bar stools and again great use of burnt orange cushions. It is bright and refreshing. Here guests can enjoy all the beautiful views. 

She also has onboard an outdoor jacuzzi with an adjoined with a large cushioned lounge area. It is completely padded with a soft white fabric that is slightly patterned, perfect to dry off after a relaxing dip. 

Her onboard toys and tenders include seabob, jet ski, snorkelling and fishing gear, towable and inflatable toys. She also has Williams 505 Diesel jet Tender, RINA commercial and MCA LY3(short range) in lieu of standard.

crew.name: Grant
crew.bio:
Position: Captain
Nationality: Australia
Grew up: Perth, Australia

About Grant:

Grant grew up in Perth, Australia where his love of the ocean begun. Hes working on many different types of boats, and even submarines! Grant has a passion for finding secluded beach spots that guests on Rascal have all to themselves! Grant will almost always be found up on the bridge of Rascal safely navigating Rascal on your incredible charter onboard Rascal

When not onboard, Grant loves to Kitesurf and fish new waters!

Favourite Yachting Destination: The Kimberleys
Favourite Yachting Experience: Navigating the beautiful waters of the Whitsundays and finding hidden beach spots

Yachts worked on: MY Suncity 32M, MY Starflyte 50M, MY Obsessions 35M, MY Driftwood 55M

Certificates of competency: STCW10, ENG1, Security Awareness, PDSD, Certificate: Australian Master Class 4 AMSA, Certificate: Marine Engine Drivers 2 AMSA, Certificate: STCW95

crew.name: Sara Edberg
crew.bio:
Position: Chief Stewardess
Nationality: Swedish
Grew up: Gothenburg, Sweden

Professional background:
Growing up on the west coast of Sweden, being close to the ocean has always felt natural for me. I'm coming from a background in real estate and sales, where you spent most of the days inside an office. So when the opportunity of working onboard a yacht and traveling the world opened up, I was quick to say yes. Living and working on a yacht is amazing, you get to work with people from across the world, meet amazing guests that all tell their stories, and explore the waters around you. How lucky are we to be spending the summers cruising the beautiful Sydney harbour and heading up to enjoy the winter up in the sunny Whitsundays. When not on the yacht, you'll find me in the snowy mountains skiing, sipping drinks along the beach or training for a marathon.

Beth has training and experience in many high-end styles of formal service, Wine and spirits, safety, medical, events and management. Her passion lies with service and ensuring guests have a trip of a lifetime onboard MY Rascal.

crew.name: Megan
crew.bio:
Position: Deckhand / Stew
Nationality: Lithuanian
Languages: English, French, German, Danish, Swedish & Russian

Professional Background:

Megan is a motivated and service-oriented Hostess and Deckhand with experience across tourism, diving, and hospitality operations in Australia. With a strong background in guest service and fluency in multiple languages, she brings excellent communication skills and a warm, professional approach to every role onboard.

Her experience includes working aboard commercial catamarans in the Whitsundays and Cairns, where she has delivered guided tours, beverage service, dive operations, guest experiences, and vessel maintenance. As an SSI Divemaster, Megan is highly confident working with guests in active marine environments and is passionate about continuing to grow her career within the yachting industry.

Megan is a professional dive guide and underwater photographer with two years experience working on the Great Barrier Reef. Specialising in guided dives and snorkel experiences with a strong marine biology focus, I enjoy capturing once-in-a-lifetime moments and special occasions above and below the surface.

Favourite Charter Destination: Whitsundays & Great Barrier Reef
Hobbies: Yoga, pilates, photography, surfing & reading
Previous Yachts: Whitsunday Bullet, Reef Encounter

crew.name: Cristiana
crew.bio:
Position: Stewardess
Nationality: Irish
Languages: English

Professional Background:

Cristiana is a highly organised hospitality professional with a strong background in guest service, venue operations, and team coordination across Ireland, Spain, and Australia. With experience in premium dining, venue management, and fast-paced hospitality environments, she brings excellent communication skills, adaptability, and a proactive approach to customer service.

Her experience includes managing teams, overseeing daily venue operations, rostering staff, coordinating bookings, and delivering high-end guest experiences in both restaurant and event settings. Combined with her academic background in Supply Chain Management and Logistics, Cristiana has developed strong operational and organisational skills that translate seamlessly into hospitality and tourism-focused environments.

Favourite Charter Destination: Whitsundays
Hobbies: Travel, coffee culture, hospitality, fitness & beach lifestyle
Previous Venues: AMP Premium, Chelsey Pizza, Popolo Italian Kitchen, Coffeeangel

crew.name: Finn
crew.bio:
Position: Bosun / Deckhand
Nationality: Australian / New Zealander
Languages: English

Professional Background:

Finn is a hardworking and highly adaptable Deckhand and Fleet Bosun with strong operational experience across private and charter vessels throughout Australia and the Whitsundays. Growing up on the Northern NSW coast with a background in surfing, boating, and fishing, he developed a natural understanding of the ocean, weather, tides, and vessel operations from a young age.

Since joining Ahoy Club in 2023, Finn has progressed into a Fleet Bosun role, managing a team of four while gaining extensive hands-on experience across a wide range of vessels from 12m-54m. His experience includes vessel passages, yard periods, tender operations, docking, maintenance, guest operations, and overall deck management. Known for his strong work ethic, attention to detail, and positive attitude, Finn thrives in team environments and is passionate about continuing to grow within the yachting industry.

Favourite Charter Destination: Whitsundays
Hobbies: Surfing, hydrofoiling, fishing, boating & cooking
Previous Yachts: M/Y Legacy, M/Y Rascal, M/Y Chaos, M/Y Double, M/Y Bluestone, M/Y Mischief, M/Y Lance, M/Y Topez, Isola, Phantom
